source_descriptions.role: Completed CPU frozen-estimator marginal SBC runner

adaptation.diagnostics.py: Portable previews, fixed parameter banks, optional per-condition streams, complete-case identities/checksums, retained failures and restartable observations/conditional draws.
adaptation.diagnostic_stats.py: Retains rank tie randomization and jitter, central sample quantiles, KS/Holm and DKW arithmetic; predictive nearest quartiles use the shared ensemble meta-score implementation.
adaptation.diagnostic_reports.py: Recomputes complete saved-result summaries without neural loading, sampling or forward simulation.
adaptation.model.py: Public wrapper accepts separate condition streams, matching the completed diagnostic runners. Original model/simulator and other extracted numerical bodies remain unchanged.

scientific_scope: Selected-MAP checks, density-wide biological target attainment and original-box-prior global marginal calibration remain distinct. Completed distribution-wide results use one final 5_3_1 estimator.
packaging_validation: Analytic controls, synthetic observations, test-double estimators, native model loading and reconciliation of compact completed evidence; no new RDME run or neural fitting.
